title: Mountain Maquette
content: Yesterday on Instagram I shared my painting "Palace in the Clouds," and some people asked:@martinez_lucas.psdWhat did you use for reference?@marcbanks_Is this completely from imagination?@s.error_Have you made a model to help in this scene?The answer is yes!For the mountain forms I draped a piece of plaster-impregnated burlap over some chunks of styrofoam, then made the buildings out of scraps of mat board hot-glued together.On top of all that I attached bits of white foam for the snow. Bringing that outside into the sunlight was a huge help for imagining the pattern of light and cast shadows.
